selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

native_visual_review.interpretation: V53/V54 native differences are subtle. Both remove substantial noise but lose fine fabric strands, small window/structure details and leaf texture. Fence wires are less colored/grid-like than RawNIND, with soft detail; no consistent broad real-photo gain from expanded training. ISO100 GFX is independently sharper and only a qualitative reference.

decision: No promotion at first1000. Expanded paired data improves synthetic photo/procedural PSNR but real-camera means are mixed and GFX native differences remain subtle. Keep V43 step2000 reference and finish both unchanged original4000-step schedules with full optimizer/EMA/RNG, then repeat the complete matched review. No convergence or SOTA claim.
